content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another records submission would not cure the authorization defect; the patient cannot properly be billed for the full provider-liability denial. With no remaining payer path or collectible secondary/patient balance, the open balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
